responsibility: Declares the public scalar-evolution interface used by GCC loop optimizers. It exposes loop-iteration and exit-condition queries, initialization/reset/finalization of the SCEV database, scalar-evolution analysis and instantiation routines, induction-variable helpers, final-value replacement, cost predicates, and small inline helpers for locating loop predecessors, instantiating parameters, and mapping CHRECs back to loop objects.
same_name_distinction: Declares the SCEV public API used by loop optimizers, including iteration queries, initialization/finalization, induction-variable helpers, and small inline loop/CHREC utilities. Unlike the .cc file, it does not compute scalar evolutions or carry out final-value replacement itself.
